message:
move cursor moved enrichment from bevy_winit to bevy_window (#25890)

# Objective

- bevy_winit is doing some processing on CursorMoved event, which made
those hard to reproduce through BRP / needed to be duplicated for other
backends


## Solution

- Move the processing to bevy_window
  - adding the delta
  - setting the window field for cusor position

## Testing

- Can follow the mouse, picking still works, focus still work, can set
the mouse position
